mount.name: Gimbal Base
mount.why: Auto-aim needs every gun to cover the full sphere around the ship. A gun glued to a pad can only shoot forward. The base owns both rotation axes so every gun cartridge gets 360° yaw and ±90° pitch for free, and gun meshes stay simple.
mount.yaw: 360° continuous around the pad axis (the yaw ring)
mount.pitch: -90° to +90° on the trunnion axis (straight up to straight down)
mount.interface: Gun cartridges have a charcoal trunnion block with a cream hexagonal axle stub on each side. The stubs drop into the two cream trunnion caps on the base's yoke. Every gun uses the same block, so any gun fits any base.
sockets: Center of the gold collar underside. Snaps to the ship's hardpoint socket.
Vertical axis through the collar center. The yoke and anything above it rotate around this.
Horizontal axis through the two trunnion caps, ~1 collar-diameter above the pad.
Same point as the pitch pivot. Gun cartridges parent here.
Center of the gun's trunnion axle. Must sit on the pitch pivot so the gun rotates about its stubs.
Projectile spawn point at the tip of the barrel, on the gun.
mount.read: gold collar, charcoal yaw ring with cream index ticks, crimson U-shaped yoke with two cream trunnion caps, empty dark cradle between the arms, no barrel
